name: bf16-tile-sweep
hypothesis: Kernel diagnostic only: sweep BF16 projection and weight-gradient tiles using the existing KS3 BF16 math, cached GS32-decoded weights and FP32 accumulation. Compare every candidate against independent FP32 products of identical BF16 operands at16k and49k rows, covering forward/backward weight layouts; time in alternating order. The saved BF16 KS3 measurement stays immutable. If hardware gains warrant implementation, require a short whole-model timing gate before any full BF16 trial. No MLP or training control is run and no convergence/reference curve is created.
cap_rule: Stop before starting an update if current elapsed plus 1.05 times the maximum of the last four observed stage update durations plus setup reserve reaches the exact budget. Setup remains on the original timer. Report any actual overrun; strict qualification has no tolerance.
preserved: Original full PR393 MoE8 top1 router, non-KS3 blocks, CPLM, global update sizes over eight logical ranks, objective schedule, optimizer settings and FP8 formats. Full 24-update warmup restored before continuous training. Raw full validation, no canonical mask, no final window extension, no tail shipping.
